nurse.text: Dia dhuit, and welcome to the Gaoth Dobhair Sanctuary! Come in out of the weather and let me see your team.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Sit down there by the fire. They'll be right as rain in a minute, and the rain here is very right.
Done, a stór. That means 'my treasure'. Slán go fóill!
The Ark is the machine in the corner. It hums in Irish, if you listen.

else.text: No bother at all. Call in any time, even just for the heat.
